question: Estimate the conversion from Diwali festive ad exposure to actual brand purchase.
idealClarificationQuestions: Brand TVC + digital + outdoor blitz reaching the consumer during Diwali? Yes.
Conversion = purchase the brand product within 30 days? Yes.
Mid-tier FMCG / consumer durables? Use consumer durables.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Festive campaign reach: 10 crore unique consumers.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Brand consideration (would consider buying): ~25% of aware = 1 crore.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Net brand-attributed purchase share of these (against competition): ~25% = ~75,000.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Per ₹100 Cr campaign cost, this is ~75,000 customers = ~₹13,000 CPA for incremental sales.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Brand awareness lift (people who saw + recall brand name)
Actual purchase (any brand from category, not necessarily this brand)
Net brand-attributed purchase share of these (against competition)

calculationFlow: Festive campaign reach: 10 crore unique consumers.
Brand awareness lift (people who saw + recall brand name): ~40% = 4 crore.
Brand consideration (would consider buying): ~25% of aware = 1 crore.
Product enquiry / store visit: ~10% of considerers = 10 lakh.
Actual purchase (any brand from category, not necessarily this brand): ~30% = 3 lakh.
Net brand-attributed purchase share of these (against competition): ~25% = ~75,000.
Per ₹100 Cr campaign cost, this is ~75,000 customers = ~₹13,000 CPA for incremental sales.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Per ₹100 Cr campaign cost, this is ~75,000 customers = ~₹13,000 CPA for incremental sales.
